Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 6 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 07 December 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon, Laguna(Liliw, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Rizal, Cavinti, Kalayaan, Lumban, Paete, San Pablo, Santa Cruz, Pila, Victoria, Calauan, Alaminos, Pakil, Pangil, Siniloan, Famy, Santa Maria, Mabitac, Bay, Los Banos) and Rizal(Tanay, Pililla, Jala-Jala).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Batangas, Cavite, Metro Manila, Laguna(Cabuyao, Calamba, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro), Rizal(Antipolo, Rodriguez, San Mateo, Angono, Baras, Binangonan, Cainta, Cardona, Morong, Taytay, Teresa) and Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, San Jose del Monte, Meycauayan, Marilao, Santa Maria, Angat, Pandi, Bocaue, Obando, Bulakan, Balagtas, Guiguinto) within the next 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZISbP.
